```html
            <path d="M4 5v6h6"/>
          </svg>
        </button>

        <div class="speed-control" role="group" aria-label="Animation speed">
          <button type="button" data-speed="0.7" aria-pressed="false">0.7x</button>
          <button type="button" data-speed="1" aria-pressed="true">1x</button>
          <button type="button" data-speed="1.45" aria-pressed="false">1.5x</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const frame = document.getElementById("frame");
      const scene = document.getElementById("scene");
      const toggle = document.getElementById("toggle");
      const reset = document.getElementById("reset");
      const speedButtons = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-speed]")];
      const animatedNodes = [...scene.querySelectorAll(".animated")];

      function setPaused(paused) {
        frame.classList.toggle("is-paused", paused);
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(paused));
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", paused ? "Play animation" : "Pause animation");
      }

      toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
        setPaused(!frame.classList.contains("is-paused"));
      });

      reset.addEventListener("click", () => {
        animatedNodes.forEach((node) => {
          node.style.animation = "none";
        });

        void scene.offsetWidth;

        animatedNodes.forEach((node) => {
          node.style.animation = "";
        });
      });

      speedButtons.forEach((button) => {
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const speed = button.dataset.speed;
          document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--speed", speed);

          speedButtons.forEach((item) => {
            item.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(item === button));
          });
        });
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```
